taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bent copper' reads as a corrupt policeman, but 'Bent' is the anagram signal working on CU plus NORMAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something columnar is shaped like a pillar, standing tall and vertical.

clue.text: Recover harem maiden's broken nail remover?

parts.note: taken as written
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: Reclaiming a nail from a broken harem girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' rearranges HAREM plus M (a maiden over in cricket scoring) into HAMMER.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpenter's tool with a split back for prising nails out is a hammer that removes them.

clue.text: Grand quality of cricket ground without boundaries

parts.note: Lord's is the famous cricket ground in London
lines mark boundaries

explanation.surface: The stately feel of a cricket ground with no boundary ropes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking', but here it has its old sense of outside, so the ground wraps round the boundaries. Lord's is a London cricket ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandeur or haughty dignity befitting a nobleman is this quality.

clue.text: Jolly Roger's ends seen in middle of Romney Marsh — odd

explanation.surface: A pirate flag spotted in the middle of the Kent marshes looks strange.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ends' gives R and R from Roger's; 'middle of' gives EYM, the central three of the eleven letters of ROMNEY MARSH; 'odd' rearranges RREYM. ROMNEY MARSH is a stretch of wetland in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: Being jolly means cheerful and full of good humour.

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Fruit seeds point to a medical problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complicated' is the anagram signal over both words; the surface plays on the old belief that swallowed fruit pips cause the condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflammation of a small organ of the gut is a medical complaint.

definitions.meaning: a set of pupils of similar ability taught together

explanation.surface: Pupils of equal ability go running.
explanation.definitionFit: Schools divide pupils by ability into groups of that name; as a verb it means to flow or pour.

clue.text: No more statement of the obvious?

definitions.meaning: an expression meaning the matter is finished
a remark that something is just what it is

explanation.surface: Enough said: this is plainly obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase closes a matter for good, and read literally it is a remark that something simply is itself.

definitions.meaning: a repeat or copy of something
in Greek myth the nymph who loved Narcissus, whose name is also the daffodil genus

explanation.surface: A copy with a classical link to a spring flower.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeated sound copies the original; in the myth, the nymph wasted away for Narcissus, and narcissus is the daffodil's genus.

indicators.note: reportedly says the word is heard rather than seen

parts.note: a teacher marks work by correcting it

explanation.surface: A rumour says a former thinker has been put right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corrects' gives MARKS, which said out loud matches the name of the nineteenth-century political philosopher.
explanation.definitionFit: Karl Marx was a nineteenth-century thinker who pictured an ideal classless society.

clue.text: Non-standard landings in disrepair drop staircases

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Unusual landings on staircases left to fall into decay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'landings' sounds like part of a staircase, which the surface leans on; here it means deliveries arriving by parachute.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplies dropped by parachute land in a way that is far from the usual route of road or runway.

clue.text: Feminine and tempestuous Earth mother's mate

indicators.note: stormy and wild, so the letters of the next word are thrown about

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Mother Earth's partner is a stormy figure with a feminine side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tempestuous' stirs up the planet's name. The grid prints P as the first letter, but no reading gives that word; the wordplay and definition both point to the male parent.
explanation.definitionFit: A mother's partner in parenting is the male parent of the family.

definitions.meaning: the traditional nickname for a carpenter
a premier picks the senior ministers who form the government

explanation.surface: French fries ordered for the head of government.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpenter making fine furniture is a craftsman of this name; a premier assembles a government's top team.

clue.text: Around 24 hours, only cash laundered for good times

money that is laundered is cleaned up and moved about, so the letters are reshuffled

a day lasts 24 hours

explanation.surface: Money laundering in cash around the clock makes for prosperous times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'laundered' rearranges ONLY CASH into HALCYONS, and 'Around' puts that round DAY.
explanation.definitionFit: A calm, happy period of past prosperity is described with this phrase, from a legendary bird said to calm the seas.

indicators.note: on says the rebuilt word follows the abbreviation, attached after it
rebuilt means put together again differently, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The Kent town of Ramsgate is redeveloped according to street plans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rebuilt' is the anagram signal and 'on' places the rearranged town after the street abbreviation. Ramsgate is a seaside town in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: Cunning schemes devised to outwit someone are crafty plans.

clue.text: Live wire initially craved to be accommodated by boy

indicators.note: being accommodated means given room inside, so these pieces go within the word for boy

parts.note: a son is a boy

indicators.note: initially says to take the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: to itch for something is to crave it

explanation.surface: An eager young man is wildly keen on electrical wiring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Live wire' reads as a lively person, but 'Live' alone is the definition; W comes from 'wire initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: A circuit that is turned on carries current, so it is electrically live.

clue.text: High German I comprehend to some extent

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Feeling elated because one understands a bit of German.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High' looks like an adjective about status or height, but it means euphoric.
explanation.definitionFit: Being high in mood means wildly elated and overexcited, the state of mania.

clue.text: Now monarchists, on being ejected, should be overthrown

explanation.walkthrough: 'being ejected' takes ON out of MONARCHISTS, leaving MARCHISTS, which 'should be overthrown' rearranges. 'Now' was the season when the puzzle appeared.
explanation.definitionFit: The puzzle ran in late December, so the present moment was the festive season.

indicators.note: cooking suggests ingredients being mixed and changed, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dish that rises as it cooks, like a souffle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooking' rearranges RISES WITH.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional stew of mutton, potatoes and onions is a dish from Ireland.

parts.note: ex is Latin for out of, meaning coming from
a china set of plates and cups is a service

explanation.surface: Imported from China, a product that used to work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country; it is crockery, a dinner service. 'formerly active' means having once served in the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who once served in the armed forces has left active duty, a veteran.

indicators.note: lacks says a piece is missing from the word for shrink

parts.note: to contract is to shrink
to con is an old word for to study

explanation.walkthrough: 'Shrink' suggests a psychiatrist, but it is the verb, contract; dropping CON leaves the area.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch of land or region is called a tract.

clue.text: On which moving rock records are made

parts.note: joint suggests a carpentry joint or a body joint, but it is a cannabis cigarette

explanation.walkthrough: 'joint' suggests anatomy or carpentry; here it is a hand-rolled cannabis cigarette.

indicators.note: half says to keep only the front portion of the word

explanation.walkthrough: 'a house' looks like a building; it is an astrological house, AQUARIUS, whose first four letters give the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale greenish-blue shade takes its name from Latin for water.

indicators.note: said says the word is spoken and heard

parts.note: a phase is a period or stage

explanation.definitionFit: To disconcert or fluster someone is to throw them off balance.

parts.note: alms are gifts to the poor

explanation.definitionFit: Doubts of conscience about whether something is right are moral misgivings.

clue.text: Opposed enemies revamped, somewhat taken aback

somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.walkthrough: 'somewhat' finds ESREVA in 'enemies revamped', and 'taken aback' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Being against something means having a strong dislike or reluctance toward it.

clue.text: Poles in Ankara tortured an American

indicators.note: in says the poles are placed inside the scrambled letters
tortured means twisted out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Polish prisoners were tortured in the Turkish capital by an American.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tortured' turns ANKARA into ARKAAN, and 'in' puts N and S inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the US state of Arkansas is an American from that state.
